# LIGHTSPEED receiver 046D:C547 ("USB Receiver") with a linked but idle PRO X
# Superlight on slot 1 whose ping reply arrives after the 4 s device timeout.
#
# Shape from owner trace 2026-11-23 (an idle, already linked mouse answered
# its slot ping after 443 to 1 288 ms; an already linked mouse never sends
# another 0x41), stretched past the timeout to show that a late reply is taken
# as a link-up. Start sequence: Solaar receiver.py notify_devices (register
# 0x02 = 0x02) makes the receiver report each paired slot with a 0x41. The
# mouse's feature indexes, name and unit id are the synthetic ones of
# receiver_mouse_discovery.txt.
#
# Format: `out <short|long> <hex>` is a frame BatterySight writes, `in` one it
# reads, `@t+<ms>` lets time pass and ticks the hub; frames shorter than their
# role (7 / 20 bytes) are zero-padded. The `out` lines after an input are the
# writes that input causes. Each `in` advances the clock by 1 ms.

# Group arrival: read the receiver's notification flags.
out short 10 FF 81 00 00 00 00
in  short 10 FF 81 00 00 01 00
# Ask the receiver to report every paired slot; it acknowledges.
out short 10 FF 80 02 02 00 00
in  short 10 FF 80 02 00 00 00
# Slot 1 linked -> Connected grant on the receiver -> ping slot 1 (4 s timeout).
in  short 10 01 41 04 00 93 40
out short 10 01 00 1B 00 00 5A
# 4.5 s pass: the ping timed out and was dropped, no write.
@t+4500
# The late reply: a sign of life from an unregistered slot -> Connected grant
# on the receiver -> ping slot 1 again.
in  long  11 01 00 1B 04 02 5A
out short 10 01 00 1B 00 00 5A
# Now awake, it answers at once and is discovered.
in  long  11 01 00 1B 04 02 5A
out short 10 01 00 0B 00 05 00
in  long  11 01 00 0B 03
out short 10 01 00 0B 00 03 00
in  long  11 01 00 0B 02
out short 10 01 00 0B 10 04 00
in  long  11 01 00 0B 06
out short 10 01 03 0B 00 00 00
in  long  11 01 03 0B 10
out short 10 01 03 1B 00 00 00
in  long  11 01 03 1B 50 52 4F 20 58 20 53 75 70 65 72 6C 69 67 68 74
out short 10 01 03 2B 00 00 00
in  long  11 01 03 2B 03
out short 10 01 02 0B 00 00 00
in  long  11 01 02 0B 00 1A 2B 3C 4D
out short 10 01 06 1B 00 00 00
# 0x1004 fn 1: 80 %, discharging -> registered.
in  long  11 01 06 1B 50 04 00 00
